openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: LHG 5 AC Based devices platform is based on the Qualcomm Atheros IPQ4018 used in various MikroTik wireless devices with 802.11a/n/ac radio, 1x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet port, 16 MB SPI NOR flash and 256 MB RAM DDR3.
Geräte: LDF5 AC (RBLDFG-5acD) NOT SUPPORTED YET BY OPENWRT!!!
openwrt_wiki.Gleiche Platine: They all share the same PCB, just the hardware name changes.
openwrt_wiki.Warnhinweis Installation: OpenWrt is not compatible with the bootloader of RouterOS v7. If is possible, downgrade RouterOS and RouterBoot to version 6.49.x or lower. Tested on versions of RouterOS with routerboot version 6.49.15.
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout: mtd0 00080000 Qualcomm; mtd1 00080000 RouterBoot; mtd2 00001000 hard_config; mtd3 000082a1 dtb_config; mtd4 00001000 soft_config; mtd5 00f00000 firmware
openwrt_wiki.Debricking: Reset Button, Mikrotik Netinstall tool; LHG5_AC Boards is based on Router OS 6, ARM Plattform (32Bit)
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Instructions for soldering pins for the serial port: Connect to RX, TX and GND. DO NOT CONNECT THE 3.3V VCC pin!!!
OpenWrt bootlog (Auszug): OF: fdt: Machine model: MikroTik SXTsq 5 ac (RBSXTsqG-5acD)
78af000.serial: ttyMSM0 at MMIO 0x78af000 (irq = 33, base_baud = 115200) is a MSM

openwrt_wiki_uart_foto.Lötpunktfeld: 2 x 5 Pads, Bestückungsdruck "SPI+UART", neben dem SPI-Flash (SOIC-8)

openwrt_git.Titel: ipq40xx: add support for MikroTik SXTsq 5 ac
openwrt_git.Beschreibung: an outdoor 802.11ac wireless CPE with one 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port
openwrt_git.LEDs: 1x Ethernet LED (green); 7x user-controllable LEDs: 1x power (blue), 1x user (green), 5x rssi (green)
openwrt_git.Note: Serial UART is probably available on the board, but it has not been tested.
openwrt_git.Flashing: Boot via TFTP the initramfs image. Then, upload a sysupgrade image via SSH and flash it normally. More info at https://openwrt.org/toh/mikrotik/common.

mikrotik_produktseite.Kurzbeschreibung: Low-cost small-size 16dBi 5GHz dual chain integrated CPE/Backbone with AC support and Gigabit Ethernet
mikrotik_produktseite.Regionen: SXTsq 5 ac-US (USA) is factory locked for 5170-5250MHz and 5725-5835MHz frequencies. This lock can not be removed. SXTsq 5 ac (International) supports 5150MHz-5875MHz range.

mikrotik_brochure.Text: compact and lightweight outdoor 5Ghz 802.11ac wireless device with an integrated antenna; weatherproof enclosure includes slots for directly attaching a hose clamp mount in three different mounting places, with ability to be mounted on horizontal railings; easily accessible grounding connection
mikrotik_brochure.Dimensions: 129 x 129 x 34 mm; package: 255 x 180 x 45 mm
mikrotik_brochure.Zubehör: QuickMount Pro adjustable mount available separately.

mikrotik_quickguide.Quickstart: Open the Ethernet door; Ethernet cable to the included PoE injector; default IP 192.168.88.1, user admin, no password
mikrotik_quickguide.Netinstall: hold the RESET button of the device when starting it, until the LED light turns off
mikrotik_quickguide.Mounting: The IP rating scale for this device is IP54. ... cable openings directed downwards ... metal mounting ring on one of the three mounting slots on the backside; ring mount for 3-7 cm diameter poles; optional quickMOUNT-X
mikrotik_quickguide.Powering: The SQ series only accepts DC power from Passive PoE injectors (one power supply and PoE injector are included). SXTsq 5 ac accepts 10-28 V DC consuming at maximum load 7 W.
mikrotik_quickguide.Ports: One Ethernet 10/100 Mbit (SXTsq 5 ac - Gigabit Ethernet), Auto MDI/X
mikrotik_quickguide.Wireless: SXTsq 5 ac 5 GHz, 802.11a/n/ac, antenna gain 16 dBi
mikrotik_quickguide.Buttons: RouterBOOT reset button: release when green LED starts flashing = reset configuration; when LED turns solid green = clear all configuration and defaults; after LED no longer lit (~20 seconds) = Netinstall; pressed before power applied = backup RouterBOOT loader
